commands.name: lint
commands.run: cd runner && { [ -d node_modules/.bin ] || npm ci --no-audit --no-fund; } && npm run lint

commands.name: typecheck
commands.run: cd runner && { [ -d node_modules/.bin ] || npm ci --no-audit --no-fund; } && npm run typecheck

setup.name: system
setup.command: curl -fsSL https://deb.nodesource.com/setup_26.x | sudo -E bash - && sudo apt-get install -y nodejs --no-install-recommends && sudo rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
